tools.name: get_country
tools.description:
Details for one EU member state: wallet, status, sources (official or not), dated history and the
        state of its relying party register. `code` is the EU country code (DE, FR, AT, EL for Greece …) or ISO code.

tools.name: get_deadlines
tools.description:
Key dates of the EUDI Wallet rollout with legal source: public relying party registers, launch of the
        German wallet d-you, mandatory acceptance for banks, energy, telecoms, very large platforms and others.
        status: confirmed (in the regulation), derived (calculated from it), expected

tools.name: get_registers
tools.description:
Daily availability check of the national registers of relying parties (public API in every member state
        from 24 December 2026 under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/848): status per country, last check, HTTP
        status, number of records, 7-day uptime. Before the deadline all registers

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description:
Standards behind the EUDI Wallet (OpenID4VCI, OpenID4VP, HAIP, SD-JWT VC, ISO/IEC 18013-5/-7 mdoc,
        Token Status List, ETSI profiles, ARF …): latest version at the publisher, the version the implementing
        regulations refer to, and the result of Eudigo's daily version check. Without `na

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description:
Definitions of EUDI Wallet and eIDAS terms (German/English) with reference to the regulation or
        specification, e.g. 'PID', 'relying party', 'access certificate', 'Zugangszertifikat', 'WUA'.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description:
Search Eudigo's reviewed articles (German and English) on the EUDI Wallet and d-you: for citizens
        (setup, security, where to use it), businesses (mandatory acceptance, registration as relying party, access
        certificates, KYC) and developers. Returns title, summary, FAQ and URL – link

tools.name: get_news
tools.description:
Eudigo's weekly news on the EUDI Wallet, newest first: one overview for Germany (d-you, legislation,
        authorities) and one for the EU (Commission and member states). Each item has a date, summary, sources
        (marked official or not) and the Eudigo URL. `weeks` limits to the latest n week

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_countries" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
